name: PaperCut NG/MF
about: Print management (tracking, quotas, secure release). On Windows it is installed on the print server and works at the Windows print queue level.
note: Written in our own words from PaperCut's public documentation. 'Relies on' means worth checking when this part of Windows changes, not that an update will break PaperCut.

depends_on.name: Windows print queues and Print Spooler
depends_on.why: PaperCut runs on the print server and holds and releases jobs on the Windows print queues; its Print Provider uses ports the Spooler hands out. Spooler crashes, often caused by drivers, stop PaperCut tracking.

depends_on.name: Remote Procedure Call (RPC)
components: Windows Remote Procedure Call Interface Definition Language (IDL)
depends_on.why: Windows clients reach the print server's Spooler over RPC (port 135 plus a dynamic range). PaperCut notes that blocking it can cause 0x0000011b and 0x0000007c errors, and the 2021 PrintNightmare fixes changed RPC printing behaviour.

depends_on.name: File sharing (SMB) for shared print queues
components: Windows SMB Server Network Transport Driver (srvnet.sys)
depends_on.why: Shared Windows print queues and macOS-to-Windows printing use SMB (port 445). PaperCut documented SMB printing from Macs breaking after the September 2021 updates and suggests LPR as an alternative.

depends_on.name: Active Directory user sync (LDAP, Kerberos)
components: Windows LDAP - Lightweight Directory Access Protocol
depends_on.why: PaperCut syncs users and groups from Active Directory or LDAP (ports 389/636) and talks to domain controllers using Kerberos (port 88). If sync breaks, new users can't print or get charged correctly.

depends_on.name: Document rendering for printing (GDI)
depends_on.why: Windows apps render documents for printing through GDI before jobs reach the queue. Not PaperCut itself, but GDI problems look like PaperCut problems: the November 2026 printing failure (zero-size images) was in this path.

past_problems.what: Network printing fails with error 0x0000011b (KB5005565 and others)
macOS-to-Windows printing over SMB stops working
Network printing fails with error 0x00000709 (KB5006670, KB5006672)
